definitions.explanation: In Buddhist terminology, departing this world to be reborn in the Pure Land. By extension, used as a euphemism for dying or passing away.

definitions.gloss: being at a loss, being stuck, giving up
definitions.explanation: Being in a helpless situation where one has no choice but to accept or give in. Often implies reluctant resignation when faced with something unavoidable.

notes:
USAGE:
Originally a Buddhist term meaning rebirth in the Pure Land after death. Sense 1 remains a respectful euphemism for dying, especially a peaceful death. Sense 2 developed from the metaphorical idea of being "dead in the water" — stuck in a situation with no way out.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大往生|だいおうじょう}: peaceful death at an old age
- {往生|おうじょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to pass away; to be stuck/helpless
- ⟦{往生際|おうじょうぎわ}が{悪|わる}い→往生際が悪い：16980_oujougiwagawarui⟧: to not know when to give up

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{逝去|せいきょ}→逝去：14370_seikyo⟧: passing away (formal, honorific)
- ⟦{困|こま}る→困る：00861_komaru⟧: to be troubled, at a loss (more casual, sense 2)
